en.Notices keep names and addresses private: Notices keep names and addresses private. Opening one rechecks the exact current page or native updater item.
en.Open to recheck and review the exact cur: Open to recheck and review the exact current item.
en.No verified changes have been recorded y: No verified changes have been recorded yet.
en.Recorded notices are rechecked when you: Recorded notices are rechecked when you open them.
en.This is a current version candidate. Exa: This is a current version candidate. Exact files, compatibility and access require separate review.
en.A current project-version candidate. Exa: A current project-version candidate. Exact file, compatibility and access still require review; nothing was downloaded or installed.
en.Current native item and version evidence: Current native item and version evidence verified.
en.The notification action was not confirme: The notification action was not confirmed. Refresh the current item.
en.The native notification did not identify: The native notification did not identify a current item.
en.Every action rechecks its exact current: Every action rechecks its exact current item. Nothing is installed from a notice.
en.Desktop notices omit names and addresses: Desktop notices omit names and addresses. Every action rechecks its exact item; it never installs or confirms file access.
en.Windows forwards clicks while the toast: Windows forwards clicks while the toast is on screen. Notices remain actionable here after the toast expires.
en.A verified change is ready to review. Op: A verified change is ready to review. Open its current item in Modhunter.
en.Current MO2 updater facts checked. Old n: Current MO2 updater facts checked. Old notices are always rechecked when opened.
en.Current MO2 updater facts are unavailabl: Current MO2 updater facts are unavailable. Page notices remain available; every item is rechecked on open.
Current MO2 updater facts are unavailable. Existing notices are rechecked on open.
This notification is no longer current. Refresh notices to review current facts.
en.MO2 facts are unavailable; page notices: MO2 facts are unavailable; page notices remain available.
en.This page observation was superseded. Re: This page observation was superseded. Review its current notice.
en.This update fact is no longer current. R: This update fact is no longer current. Refresh notices.
en.The native profile, game or item generat: The native profile, game or item generation changed. Refresh notices.
en.This notification was dismissed or super: This notification was dismissed or superseded.
en.Notification facts are already being ref: Notification facts are already being refreshed.

es.Notices keep names and addresses private: Los avisos mantienen privados los nombres y las direcciones. Al abrir uno se vuelve a comprobar la página o el elemento exacto del actualizador nativo.
es.Open to recheck and review the exact cur: Abre el aviso para volver a comprobar y revisar el elemento actual exacto.
es.No verified changes have been recorded y: Aún no se han registrado cambios verificados.
es.Recorded notices are rechecked when you: Los avisos registrados se vuelven a comprobar al abrirlos.
es.This is a current version candidate. Exa: Es una versión candidata actual. Los archivos exactos, la compatibilidad y el acceso requieren una revisión aparte.
es.A current project-version candidate. Exa: Una versión candidata actual del proyecto. El archivo exacto, la compatibilidad y el acceso aún requieren revisión; no se ha descargado ni instalado nada.
es.Current native item and version evidence: Se han verificado el elemento nativo actual y los datos de versión.
es.The notification action was not confirme: No se ha confirmado la acción del aviso. Actualiza el elemento actual.
es.The native notification did not identify: La notificación nativa no identificó ningún elemento actual.
es.Every action rechecks its exact current: Cada acción vuelve a comprobar su elemento actual exacto. No se instala nada desde un aviso.
es.Desktop notices omit names and addresses: Los avisos del escritorio omiten nombres y direcciones. Cada acción vuelve a comprobar su elemento exacto; nunca instala ni confirma el acceso a archivos.
es.Windows forwards clicks while the toast: Windows transmite los clics mientras el aviso está en pantalla. Cuando desaparece, puedes seguir abriéndolo aquí.
es.A verified change is ready to review. Op: Hay un cambio verificado listo para revisar. Abre su elemento actual en Modhunter.
es.Current MO2 updater facts checked. Old n: Se han comprobado los datos actuales del actualizador de MO2. Los avisos anteriores siempre se vuelven a comprobar al abrirlos.
es.Current MO2 updater facts are unavailabl: Los datos actuales del actualizador de MO2 no están disponibles. Los avisos de páginas siguen disponibles; cada elemento se vuelve a comprobar al abrirlo.
Los datos actuales del actualizador de MO2 no están disponibles. Los avisos existentes se vuelven a comprobar al abrirlos.
Este aviso ya no está actualizado. Actualiza los avisos para revisar los datos actuales.
Datos actuales de las notificaciones actualizados.
es.MO2 facts are unavailable; page notices: Los datos de MO2 no están disponibles; los avisos de páginas siguen disponibles.
es.This page observation was superseded. Re: Esta observación de la página ha sido sustituida. Revisa su aviso actual.
es.This update fact is no longer current. R: Este dato de actualización ya no está vigente. Actualiza los avisos.
es.The native profile, game or item generat: Ha cambiado el perfil nativo, el juego o la revisión del elemento. Actualiza los avisos.
es.This notification was dismissed or super: Este aviso se ha descartado o sustituido.
es.Notification facts are already being ref: Ya se están actualizando los datos de las notificaciones.

it.Notices keep names and addresses private: Gli avvisi mantengono riservati nomi e indirizzi. Aprendone uno, viene ricontrollata la pagina o la voce esatta dell’aggiornamento nativo.
it.A version candidate was recorded: È stata registrata una versione candidata
it.Open to recheck and review the exact cur: Apri per ricontrollare e verificare la voce attuale esatta.
it.No verified changes have been recorded y: Non sono ancora state registrate modifiche verificate.
it.Recorded notices are rechecked when you: Gli avvisi registrati vengono ricontrollati quando li apri.
it.This is a current version candidate. Exa: Questa è una versione candidata attuale. I file esatti, la compatibilità e l’accesso richiedono una verifica separata.
it.A current project-version candidate. Exa: Una versione candidata attuale del progetto. Il file esatto, la compatibilità e l’accesso richiedono ancora una verifica; non è stato scaricato o installato nulla.
it.Current native item and version evidence: Voce nativa attuale e dati della versione verificati.
it.The notification action was not confirme: L’azione della notifica non è stata confermata. Aggiorna la voce attuale.
it.The native notification did not identify: La notifica nativa non ha identificato una voce attuale.
it.Every action rechecks its exact current: Ogni azione ricontrolla la voce attuale esatta. Nessun avviso avvia un’installazione.
it.Desktop notices omit names and addresses: Gli avvisi desktop omettono nomi e indirizzi. Ogni azione ricontrolla la voce esatta; non installa né conferma l’accesso ai file.
it.Windows forwards clicks while the toast: Windows inoltra i clic mentre la notifica è sullo schermo. Dopo la sua scadenza, gli avvisi restano apribili qui.
it.A verified change is ready to review. Op: Una modifica verificata è pronta per la revisione. Apri la voce attuale in Modhunter.
it.Current MO2 updater facts checked. Old n: Dati attuali dell’aggiornamento MO2 verificati. Gli avvisi precedenti vengono sempre ricontrollati all’apertura.
it.Current MO2 updater facts are unavailabl: I dati attuali dell’aggiornamento MO2 non sono disponibili. Restano gli avvisi delle pagine; ogni voce viene ricontrollata all’apertura.
I dati attuali dell’aggiornamento MO2 non sono disponibili. Gli avvisi esistenti vengono ricontrollati all’apertura.
Questa notifica non è più attuale. Aggiorna gli avvisi per verificare i dati correnti.
it.MO2 facts are unavailable; page notices: I dati di MO2 non sono disponibili; restano disponibili gli avvisi delle pagine.
it.This page observation was superseded. Re: Questa osservazione della pagina è stata sostituita. Verifica il suo avviso attuale.
it.This update fact is no longer current. R: Questo dato di aggiornamento non è più attuale. Aggiorna gli avvisi.
it.The native profile, game or item generat: Il profilo nativo, il gioco o la revisione della voce è cambiato. Aggiorna gli avvisi.
it.This notification was dismissed or super: Questa notifica è stata ignorata o sostituita.
it.Notification facts are already being ref: I dati delle notifiche sono già in aggiornamento.

zh-TW.Notices keep names and addresses private: 通知不顯示名稱與網址。開啟通知時，會重新核對目前的確切網頁或原生更新項目。
zh-TW.Open to recheck and review the exact cur: 開啟以重新核對並檢閱目前的確切項目。
zh-TW.No verified changes have been recorded y: 尚未記錄已驗證的變更。
zh-TW.Recorded notices are rechecked when you: 開啟已記錄的通知時，會重新核對其資訊。
zh-TW.Verified native updater item: 已驗證的原生更新項目
zh-TW.This is a current version candidate. Exa: 這是目前的候選版本。確切檔案、相容性與存取權限仍須另行檢閱。
zh-TW.A current project-version candidate. Exa: 目前的專案候選版本。確切檔案、相容性與存取權限仍須檢閱；尚未下載或安裝任何內容。
zh-TW.Current native item and version evidence: 已核對目前的原生項目與版本證據。
zh-TW.The notification action was not confirme: 尚未確認通知操作。請重新整理目前項目。
zh-TW.The native notification did not identify: 原生通知未識別出目前項目。
zh-TW.Every action rechecks its exact current: 每次操作都會重新核對目前的確切項目。通知不會安裝任何內容。
zh-TW.Desktop notices omit names and addresses: 桌面通知不顯示名稱與網址。每次操作都會重新核對確切項目；不會安裝內容或確認檔案存取權限。
zh-TW.Windows forwards clicks while the toast: Windows 會在快顯通知顯示於畫面時傳遞點擊。快顯通知消失後，仍可在此開啟通知。
zh-TW.A verified change is ready to review. Op: 已驗證的變更可供檢閱。請在 Modhunter 開啟目前項目。
zh-TW.Current MO2 updater facts checked. Old n: 已檢查目前的 MO2 更新資訊。開啟舊通知時，一律會重新核對。
zh-TW.Current MO2 updater facts are unavailabl: 目前無法取得 MO2 更新資訊。網頁通知仍可使用；開啟時會重新核對每個項目。
目前無法取得 MO2 更新資訊。開啟現有通知時會重新核對。
此通知已不是目前狀態。請重新整理通知以檢閱最新資訊。
已重新整理目前的通知資訊。
zh-TW.MO2 facts are unavailable; page notices: 無法取得 MO2 資訊；網頁通知仍可使用。
已驗證目前項目的身分。
zh-TW.This page observation was superseded. Re: 此網頁觀察結果已被取代。請檢閱目前通知。
zh-TW.This update fact is no longer current. R: 此更新資訊已不是目前狀態。請重新整理通知。
zh-TW.The native profile, game or item generat: 原生設定檔、遊戲或項目世代已變更。請重新整理通知。
zh-TW.This notification was dismissed or super: 此通知已關閉或被取代。
zh-TW.Notification facts are already being ref: 正在重新整理通知資訊。
